description.fun: A little crystal bud that clings to cave walls and ceilings, sucking out nutrients. Its 'petals' are made of crystallized poison, and to protect itself it scatters poisonous powder like pollen or strikes with its poison-packed bud. Nobody fully understands it yet, but it seems to be connected to the Terastal phenomenon, turning up in Area Zero and the Crystal Pool.
description.guide: A Rock and Poison-type Pokémon from Pokémon Scarlet and Violet with petal-like crystals of poison. It is thought to be connected to the Terastal phenomenon. It evolves into Glimmora.
description.tagline: A poison crystal bud clinging to cave walls

description.fun: Glimmet blooms into a large flower of crystallized poison energy, and it has recently become clear that its petals look just like Tera Jewels. It clings to walls disguised as a plant, and when it senses danger, it opens its crystalline petals and fires beams from its cone. It teams up with groups of Glimmet to drive enemies off.
description.guide: The evolution of Glimmet, a Rock and Poison-type flower Pokémon made of crystallized poison and linked to the Terastal phenomenon. It gained a Mega Evolution in the Mega Dimension expansion for Pokémon Legends: Z-A.
description.tagline: A crystal flower whose petals look like Tera Jewels

description.fun: Its outer petals grow larger, break away from its body and orbit around it, shielding it while they scatter poisonous fragments over a wider area. Its cone stretches tall and its eyes turn red.
